audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated COGS % margin (39.75%) but only derived it from C02 (COGS=$15,357M). audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: COGS percentage margin calculated as 39.75% based only on COGS value without dividing by revenue
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated COGS % margin (39.75%) but only derived it from C02 (COGS=$15,357M). The calculation should be COGS/Revenue = 15,357/38,655 = 39.75%, but the analyst never incorporated C01 (net operating revenues=$38,655M) which was extracted for year 2022, not 2021. The extractor extracted revenue for 2022 but COGS for 2021, creating a year mismatch. The analyst should have flagged missing 2021 revenue data, but instead produced a percentage that numerically happens to match COGS/2022 Revenue, suggesting incomplete derivation logic.
